issue.title: Login page shows "Enter your handle to sign in." under every provider LoginForm
issue.body:
On the admin login page, when an auth provider with a `LoginForm` is open, the help line under the card reads "Enter your handle to sign in." (`packages/admin/src/components/LoginPage.tsx`: the help paragraph at the end of the page, in the `activeProvider` branch). The wording is specific to the Atmosphere provider; for an email and password form it tells people to type a handle.

Reproduce: register any provider whose admin entry exports `LoginForm` (for example one asking for email and password), open `/_emdash/admin/login`, click its button.

Possible fix: let the provider module export an optional `loginHelp` string (or component) and fall back to a neutral line such as "Continue with {label}." when it is absent.

EmDash 1.1.0, `@emdash-cms/admin` 1.1.0. Checked on `main` on 2026-10-08: still there.

Written with AI assistance (Claude Code).
